description: Add a scroll-to-top button that appears on recipe list pages when users scroll down, allowing them to quickly return to the top of the page. This button should be visible on recipe lists, favorite lists, and cookbook pages. The button should have appropriate styling for both desktop and mobile views.
functional_requirements: Create a reusable scroll-to-top component that appears in the bottom-right corner of the viewport
Show the button only when the user has scrolled beyond a certain threshold on recipe list pages
Implement smooth scrolling animation when the button is clicked to return to the top of the page
Add appropriate iconography for the scroll-to-top action
Ensure the button is responsive and properly styled for both desktop and mobile devices
Integrate the component into recipe card sections, favorite lists, and cookbook pages
